Northwind Support FAQ

How do I reset the controller?

Hold the RESET button for 10 seconds until the status LED blinks amber, then power-cycle the cabinet.

Where can I download firmware?

Firmware is available on the partner portal under Downloads > Controllers. The current release is 4.3.1.
